integrity: All finite counts come from two complete Eulerian-cycle generators and two independent run algorithms in the embedded standard-library checker; code and full 2048-row table are provided. The review is self-review only, not independent scientific certification.
scientific_limitations: The six-cell joint spectrum is proved only for binary order-five de Bruijn cycles. The general period restriction and unary-run formula hold at every binary order at least three. An unindexed earlier finite enumeration cannot be ruled out.
title: Exact circular maximal-repetition runs in order-five binary de Bruijn cycles
